That is why EDI at 009EE580 still holds the literal 2 from 009ED7EC rather than the &blk+39Ch that 009EDFA1 loads. 009EE580-009EE670 is now projected as ship_ai_pick_path_point_009ee580: 009EE5C2 refreshes the path plan through 009ED3E0 from the goal blk+1DCh, 009EE5F4 asks 009E3C00 for the path point, and 009EE66C publishes its lateral band through 00815F30. docs/SHIP_AI_GOAL_VECTOR.md
